shortDescription: This module manages certificate trust stores for replication on IBM Storage Virtualize family systems

options.name: clustername
options.description: The hostname or management IP of the Storage Virtualize system.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain for the Storage Virtualize storage system. Valid when hostname is used for the parameter I(clustername).

options.name: email
options.description: Specifies the certificates in the store are used to validate the email server.

options.name: grid
options.description: Specifies the certificates in the store are used for the flashsystem grid.

options.name: ipsec
options.description: Specifies the certificates in the store are used for the IPsec service.

options.name: key_filename
options.description: SSH client private key filename. By default, ~/.ssh/id_rsa is used.

options.name: log_path
options.description: Path of debug log file.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the trust store.

options.name: password
options.description: Password for the Storage Virtualize system. Mandatory, when I(usesshkey=no).

options.name: remote_clustername
options.description: Specifies the name of the partner remote cluster with which mTLS partnership needs to be setup.

options.name: remote_domain
options.description: Domain for the Storage Virtualize storage system. Valid when hostname is used for the parameter I(remote_clustername).

options.name: remote_password
options.description: Password for remote cluster. Applies when I(state=present) to create a trust store.

options.name: remote_username
options.description: Username for remote cluster. Applies when I(state=present) to create a trust store.

options.name: restapi
options.description: Specifies the certificates in the store are used for the REST API.

options.name: snmp
options.description: Specifies the certificates in the store are used to validate the SNMP servers.

options.name: state
options.description: Creates (C(present)) or deletes (C(absent)) a trust store.

options.name: syslog
options.description: Specifies the certificates to be bundled and provided to rsyslog client for making TLS connections.

options.name: username
options.description: Username for the Storage Virtualize system.

options.name: usesshkey
options.description: For key-pair based SSH connection, set this field as "yes". Provide full path of key in key_filename field. If not provided, default path of SSH key is used.

options.name: vasa
options.description: Specifies the certificates in the store are used for the VASA Provider.
